items.claim: CFO raises full-year 2025 group adjusted EBITDA guidance range.
items.quote: our EBITDA guidance to the $490 million and $500 million
items.speaker: CFO (Peter Oey)

items.claim: CEO reiterates full-year on-demand GMV growth will accelerate versus 2024.
items.quote: on-demand GMV growth to accelerate from 2024 levels
items.speaker: CEO (Anthony Tan)

items.claim: COO says Q4 on-demand GMV expected to grow sequentially from Q3.
items.quote: we expect fourth quarter on-demand GMV to grow sequentially
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO restates long-term segment margin targets for deliveries and mobility.
items.quote: deliverers to 4% plus and mobility to 9% plus
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: CFO cites operating leverage improvement in regional corporate costs as percentage of revenue.
items.quote: 150 basis points improvement in operating leverage
items.speaker: CFO (Peter Oey)

items.claim: COO characterizes Indonesia delivery margin as stable despite continued growth investment.
items.quote: the margin is stable, we're actually able to generate
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO says Malaysia has already reached the company's steady-state delivery margin target.
items.quote: we've already reached our steady state margin target
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO describes Indonesia as remaining a very competitive market.
items.quote: It remains a very competitive market.
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO states comfort with Grab's market position and penetration in Indonesia.
items.quote: we're very comfortable with what we're doing
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: CFO restates the three-pillar capital allocation framework is unchanged.
items.quote: our focus as always on three pillars
items.speaker: CFO (Peter Oey)

items.claim: CFO cites the WeRide and May Mobility deals as examples of selective, high-bar M&A in autonomous vehicles.
items.quote: You've seen the announcement that we made with WeRide
items.speaker: CFO (Peter Oey)

items.claim: CFO describes Q3 loan disbursal growth on an annualized basis as a capital deployment example.
items.quote: Q3 alone was up roughly about 56% on a year-over-year
items.speaker: CFO (Peter Oey)

items.claim: CFO says excess capital beyond organic growth and M&A will be returned to shareholders.
items.quote: we'll obviously look at returning it to our shareholders
items.speaker: CFO (Peter Oey)

items.claim: COO describes GrabMore, a feature letting food-delivery users add grocery items to the same order.
items.quote: GrabMore where a food user can just add on a grocery order
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO describes early-stage quick-commerce experiments using Jaya grocery store assets in Malaysia.
items.quote: experimenting with quick commerce around certain Jaya stores
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO calls GrabUnlimited the largest paid subscription program in Southeast Asia, up 14% YoY.
items.quote: GrabUnlimited is the biggest subscription program
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: CEO states Southeast Asia labor costs remain low relative to the U.S., delaying AV unit-economics parity.
items.quote: Southeast Asia is still behind in the cost curve
items.speaker: CEO (Anthony Tan)

items.claim: COO acknowledges rising expected credit losses in Financial Services from the models used to provision for growth.
items.quote: an increase in the expected credit losses
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO says about a third of financial-services borrowers previously had no credit bureau data before borrowing from Grab.
items.quote: About 1/3 of our customers could not access data
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO says Saver deliveries account for nearly a third of new delivery MTUs joining the platform.
items.quote: almost 1/3 of our deliveries MTUs
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO reaffirms the goal to exceed a $1 billion loan book (ex. credit loss provisions) by end of 2025.
items.quote: we are reaffirming our goal to exceed a $1 billion loan book
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: COO reiterates Financial Services segment will reach breakeven overall in the second half, with banks breaking even in Q4.
items.quote: we will breakeven overall as a segment in the second half
items.speaker: COO (Alex Hungate)

items.claim: CFO commits the IR team to an upcoming roadshow across multiple regions.
items.quote: We'll be on the road together with the IR team
items.speaker: CFO (Peter Oey)

qa_flags.question: Goldman Sachs analyst asked for specific color/metrics on the growth Grab has achieved in Indonesia specifically, given the 24% YoY group on-demand growth.
qa_flags.response_pattern: COO did not provide an Indonesia-specific growth figure; instead said 'you can't see these in the numbers, but I can tell you that there's strong growth in Indonesia' and pivoted to qualitative commentary on product strategy and 'strong sequential margin improvement' without quantifying either.
